mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and reduced equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a deepening economic contraction, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and INDPRO falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 900.0 fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 360,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 360.0 fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A real personal consumption level (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 380.0 fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
